pages.text: Research is paid for in $(thing)Insight$(), and Insight comes from observing things with the $(item)Spectral Analyzer$(): on the Extreme Assembly Table from 9 $(item)Amethyst Shard$(), 27 $(item)Neutronium Ingot$(), 9 $(item)Cherenkov Quartz$() (or found in Observatory Ruins).

Every $(thing)new$() observation counts once:$(li)$(thing)Sneak + use$() it in the air: the sky of the dimension you are in - 8 Insight each for the Overworld, the Nether, the End and every other world.$(li)Use it on unusual blocks - amethyst clusters, budding amethyst, obsidian, crying obsidian, magma, glowstone, spawners, enchanting tables, beacons, sculk... - 3 each.$(li)On creatures - endermen, blazes, ghasts, phantoms, shulkers, wardens... - 6 each.$(li)On a $(thing)running$() machine of this mod: 4, or 12 for a multiblock.
The first research, $(thing)Quantum Foundations$(), costs only 5 Insight: observing the Overworld sky is enough. Later, machines running $(thing)thought experiments$() make Insight without end.
